investigation_notes.Matched Content Excerpt: Access to the Vitalis Healthcare primary data center requires connection to the internal VPN gateway at 10.45.2.112. Authentication is handled via the Vitalis-DC01 domain controller. If the primary tunnel fails, technicians should failover to the secondary Cisco ASA node (v-asa-ext-02.vitalis.com) using the shared certificate stored in the /dev/certs/internal/ directory.
investigation_notes.Sensitive Indicators: Internal VPN gateway IP 10.45.2.112; domain controller hostname Vitalis-DC01; ASA host v-asa-ext-02.vitalis.com; certificate path /dev/certs/internal/
investigation_notes.Description: The alert identifies a document on a public Scribd page that contains detailed Vitalis Healthcare internal infrastructure information including an internal VPN gateway IP, a domain controller hostname, an ASA hostname, and a shared certificate path. These items represent sensitive configuration details that could assist targeted attackers or credential misuse; although the VPN IP is a private RFC1918 address and not directly routable, the presence of a resolvable ASA hostname and certificate artifacts increases risk. No prior similar alerts were found, and the combination of explicit internal identifiers and public hosting justifies a High Priority classification.
